Eames inside your room

Original chair and ottoman inside the server-selected room (verified on Render). No added studio walls or ceiling panel. External daylight is supplied because the room has no authored lights.

Experimental adaptive sampling: known lighting artifacts remain. Six bounces, 32/16/8/4/2/1 SPP rings (5.95 average). Optional rough-surface denoising changes presentation only. Not real-time or quality-qualified.

Placement moves the Eames chair and ottoman together. Additional models keep their source scale and default materials. Changes apply on Render; wall collisions are not checked. FOV defaults to 52° (previously 62°); this remains a single-camera, not stereo, view.

Additional assets are loaded only from the local server and verified on Render.

Splitting requires the stable sampler. It adds secondary rays, not camera SPP. No split after the selected depth.

Splitting benchmark always has denoising off and uses the stable sampler for every variant: one warmup, three rotated timing rounds, then diagnostic images. Keep this tab visible; it may take several minutes.

Ready. Render to view the Eames inside the room.
